title: Modular powers of binary coefficient vectors
statement: Let $\ell>0$, let $m$ be the low-coefficient vector of a monic irreducible polynomial of degree $\ell$ over $\mathbb F_2$, and let $r\in\mathbb F_2^\ell$. Define a sequence of coefficient vectors by $P_0=(1,0,\ldots,0)$ and $P_{e+1}=P_e r$ modulo that polynomial, where multiplication is performed by the specified modular multiplication routine. The value at exponent $e$ is $P_e$.
hypotheses_covered: modulus vector comes from a certified irreducible binary polynomial
